<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.63.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* [feature] Add `wrap` to `st.pills` and `st.segmented_control` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16369
* [feature] Add `on_change="ignore"` mode to st.slider by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14828
* [feature] Auto no-wrap for direct column widgets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16578
* [feature] Add `type="step"` to `st.expander` and `st.status` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16558
* [feature] Make st.rerun() work in widget callbacks by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16158
* [feature] Add `on_change="ignore"` mode to st.text_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16605
* [feature] Configurable cache background-refresh TTL multiplier by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16599
* [feature] Add select_all and first-row Enter to st.multiselect by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16673
* [feature] Add wrap parameter to text commands by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16617
* [feature] Add icon parameter to title, header, subheader by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16418
* [feature] Add event-scoped fragment reruns via st.rerun(scope=<key>) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16161
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Skip syntax highlighting for very long code blocks (#11996) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16567
* [fix] Keep menu and JSON overlays clickable in `st.dialog` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16583
* [fix] Clamp date/datetime input default bounds at date.min/max by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16582
* [fix] Match skills-nudge button labels to the card's text size by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16482
* [fix] Stop Cmd/Ctrl+C from opening clear-cache dialog by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16615
* [fix] Prevent markdown lists from overflowing narrow containers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16632
* [fix] Echo guest-to-host messages to in-iframe hosts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16647
* [fix] Restore Ctrl/Cmd+A in st.multiselect filter by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16650
* [fix] Correct public widget overload typings by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16633
* [fix] Error message bullets and uppercase-hex object reprs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16683
* [fix] Show the correct year in the date picker header by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16706
* [fix] Harden AppTest for keys, disabled widgets, and navigation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16711
* [fix] Log all user-facing warnings to the console by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16717
* [fix] Prevent upload hang when middleware reads the body first by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16709
* [fix] Keep a time given before a date in st.datetime_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16664
### Other Changes
* [chore] Release v1.62.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16579
* [docs] Recommend st.table for key-value lists by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16576
* [docs] Clarify UploadedFile public API by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16604
* [fix] Keep spinner moving and expose its label by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16620
* [refactor] Add typed API exceptions for telemetry by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16637
* [refactor] Add missing-required parameter error by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16508
* [docs] Recommend icons for navigation pages by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16658
* [refactor] Adopt shared parameter exception types by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16668
* [refactor] Finish public API exception cleanup by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16656
* [refactor] Adopt specific Streamlit API errors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16690
* [refactor] Split range errors into min/max vs interval by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16701
* [refactor] Improve `st.context` and `st.user` typing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16710
* [refactor] Migrate leftover st.* exception types by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16707
* [docs] Document that st.rerun() works in widget callbacks by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16751
* [docs] Update agent skill for keyed fragment reruns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16750


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.62.0...1.63.0
